component.name: Atomsk GUI
component.summary: Graphical front end for the Atomsk atomic structure tool

description.p: Atomsk GUI lets you build, modify and convert atomic structures with the Atomsk command-line program. Pick a crystal lattice, fill in its parameters, then apply any Atomsk option from searchable drop-down lists. All work is done by the Atomsk backend, which is not bundled: install it separately or let the app download it on first start.
